data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate shows modest favourable prior-year development at year end 2015. Analysis of the gross claims development table indicates an aggregate release on older underwriting years (2011-2013) of approximately GBP 6.3m, driven by favourable claims development and recoveries from reinsurance. The overall gross claims outstanding increased year-on-year due to current-year claims and movements, but the prior-years (excluding 2014-2015) show net improvement.
raw_causal_phrases: The tables below show the Syndicate's cumulative incurred claims development, including both claims notified and IBNR for each underwriting year, together with the cumulative payments to date on a gross and net of reinsurance basis at the balance sheet date.

The uncertainty associated with the ultimate claims experience of an underwriting year is greatest when the underwriting year is at an early stage of development and the margin for future experience potentially being more adverse than assumed is at its highest.
The Syndicate purchases reinsurance as part of its risks mitigation programme.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount derived by applying the triangle diagonal comparison method to the gross claims development table (page 33) excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2015 and 2014). No single explicit gross prior-year movement sentence was provided; the reconciliation/movement line in the technical provisions table includes current year movements and therefore was not used for PYD. RITC / reinsurance interactions and the presence of reinsurance acceptances may distort comparisons; numbers in development table are presented in '000. Confidence in PYD is moderate (0.8).
